title: Verify Calcite set-operation matches and the UNION ALL control
description: Repeat the eight original-method debugger trials for the EXCEPT ALL and INTERSECT ALL intent and duplicate-input histories. Independently repeat all three JDBC histories with Calcite's public planner listener. Follow the converted and trimmed relational trees, count attempts and successful project transpositions, and verify the returned rows. The UNION ALL projection disappears during field trimming before the registered rule can match.
expected: Both revisions attempt the changed rule on the difference and intersection queries. Only the parent produces those transforms. Both trim the outer UNION ALL projection and return two tens with zero attempts of the registered rule. All twelve listener JVMs and eight debugger trials match.
